What this run shows about the strategy

Measured on this run's own baskets and fills; the numbers are in diagnostics.json.

1
89.3% of baskets win, and it needs 93.9% to break even
The average winner is $1.40, the average loser -$21.56: one average loss cancels 15 wins. The worst basket (-$308.92) cancels 221. The 10 worst baskets gave back 100% of everything the winners made. The margin over break-even is -4.7 points.
2
The ladder's big tiers fire together, at one price
43% of all ladder adds came within 3 seconds of the previous fill. By tier: M15 fired within 10 s of the add before it 88% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.15 per unit away); H1 fired within 10 s of the add before it 98% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.14 per unit away); H4 fired within 10 s of the add before it 100% of the time (median 2 s later, $0.11 per unit away). Those tiers carry most of the basket's size, so the 'averaging' is one large clip, not a ladder.
3
Full ladders: 83% win $4.79, the rest lose -$174.64
90 baskets reached all 6 positions; together they made -$2,260.48 (worst -$308.92). Baskets with no add made $1,212.38 in total; baskets with at least one add made -$3,218.50.
4
The slope exit closes losers near their worst price
64% of losing baskets were closed within 10% of the largest loss they ever showed. Losers were held a median 14 minutes (one in ten longer than 1.1 h, the longest 58.6 h); 34% of them had been in profit first. Winners were at worst -$335.20 under water before coming back.
5
Spread paid: $949.44
That is 40% of the gross profit of the winning baskets; before spread the run would have netted -$1,056.68 instead of -$2,006.12. Median spread at entry: $0.16 per unit.

Where the money came from, and where it went

While flat the bot polled 2,180,071 times: the open score wanted a trade but the force-close score vetoed it on 25.9% of those polls, the re-entry cooldown blocked a ready signal on 22.5%, and the trading window on 1.7%. A ladder tier hit its RSI level but was held back by the open-score gate on 6,175 polls; 54,621 polls were spent holding a full ladder.
